mapper.select: SELECT rp.id, rp.product_name, rp.product_detail_type, rp.max_headcount, rp.price_per_unit, rp.price_unit, m.id AS merchant_id, m.name AS merchant_name, m.category AS merchant_category, m.region_id AS merchant_region_id FROM reservation_products rp JOIN merchants m ON m.id = rp.merchant_id WHERE rp.id = #{productId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservations ( user_id, workation_id, product_id, reservation_code, start_date, end_date, headcount, quantity, total_amount, status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{workationId}, #{productId}, #{reservationCode}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{headcount}, #{quantity}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, NOW() )
mapper.sql: FROM reservations r JOIN reservation_products rp ON rp.id = r.product_id JOIN merchants m ON m.id = rp.merchant_id
mapper.select:
SELECT r.id AS reservation_id, r.reservation_code, m.name AS merchant_name, rp.product_name, rp.product_detail_type, rp.thumbnail_url, r.start_date, r.end_date, r.headcount, r.quantity, r.total_amount, r.status, CASE WHEN r.status = 'CANCELED' THEN rc.canceled_at ELSE NULL END AS canceled_at, CASE WHEN r.status = 'CANCELED' THEN rc.refund_amount ELSE NULL END AS refund_amount
LEFT JOIN reservation_cancels rc ON rc.id = ( SELECT rc2.id FROM reservation_cancels rc2 WHERE rc2.reservation_id = r.id ORDER BY rc2.canceled_at DESC, rc2.id DESC LIMIT 1 )
ORDER BY canceled_at DESC, reservation_id DESC
ORDER BY start_date ASC, reservation_id DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT r.id AS reservation_id, r.reservation_code, r.workation_id, m.id AS merchant_id, m.name AS merchant_name, m.category AS merchant_category, m.address AS merchant_address, m.phone_number AS merchant_phone_number, m.thumbnail_url AS merchant_thumbnail_url, rp.id AS product_id, rp.product_name, rp.product_detail_type, rp.thumbnail_url AS product_thumbnail_url, r.start_date, r.end_date, r.headcount, r.quantity, r.total_amount, ( SELECT t.payment_source_type FROM transactions t WHERE t.reservation_id = r.id AND t.transaction_type = 'PAYMENT' AND t.status = 'PAID' ORDER BY t.approved_at DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS payment_method, r.status, r.created_at, rv.review_id, rv.status AS review_status FROM reservations r JOIN reservation_products rp ON rp.id = r.product_id JOIN merchants m ON m.id = rp.merchant_id LEFT JOIN reviews rv ON rv.reservation_id = r.id WHERE r.id = #{reservationId} AND r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'COMPLETED')

SELECT r.id AS reservation_id, r.reservation_code, m.name AS merchant_name, rp.product_name, rp.product_detail_type, rp.thumbnail_url, r.start_date, r.end_date, r.total_amount, rc.canceled_at, rc.cancel_fee, rc.refund_amount FROM reservations r JOIN reservation_products rp ON rp.id = r.product_id JOIN merchants m ON m.id = rp.merchant_id JOIN reservation_cancels rc ON rc.reservation_id = r.id WHERE r.id = #{reservationId} AND r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 'CANCELED'
